subject: Re: Inquiry Regarding Deletion of Individual Image IDs in Encord
text:
Hi Kate,

Thanks for the clarification.

Our request is specifically about having an option to delete:

   1. Entire tasks are no longer needed.
   2. Individual images within a task.

For example, if a task contains 4–5 images and we identify that 1–2 are
incorrect, duplicated, low-quality, or uploaded by mistake, there is
currently no option to remove only those specific images while keeping the
rest of the task intact.

Deleting the entire dataset is not ideal in our case, especially if it is
linked to multiple projects. We would prefer more granular control at the
task/image level.

An archive workflow helps with completed tasks, but it does not address
removing unwanted images from an existing task.

Best Regards,
Prasad Jena

Key points 1. Antoine's Projects: Antoine is an autonomous system engineer, full-time at Project Q, and also consults for another company. He is evaluating Encord for three projects: maritime autonomy (camera, radar, Ross mcap data), drone detection (audio data) for Project Q, and underwater acoustic warfare (audio annotation) for his consultancy.

5. Modality Support: Antoine confirmed they also have seismic data, which would come through as time series. He was attracted to Encord's support for mcap files and its multi-modal capabilities. 
6. SaaS vs. On-Premise: James addressed potential concerns about using a SaaS vendor in the defense space, explaining that Encord works with confidential data and complies with EU regulations. He offered to provide a one-pager on data retention and compliance.
